evals.prompt: ok i think we're done for today, let me commit what we have. i ran the continuity seed skill earlier and also wrote an IB for the new module. git add -A and commit
evals.expected_output: The skill fires before the commit, scans for bare default names, finds CONTINUITY_SEED.md and IB.md, runs the orphan-duplicate check for each, and either renames/deletes them or surfaces ambiguity -- before allowing the git commit to proceed.
assertions: The skill identifies CONTINUITY_SEED.md as a bare skill-default name
The skill identifies IB.md as a bare skill-default name
The skill runs an orphan-duplicate check (compares to any timestamped siblings)
The skill does NOT proceed with git commit until all bare files are resolved
The skill states a gate verdict before proceeding

evals.prompt: hygiene sweep before push. working tree has: CONTINUITY_SEED_2026-05-01.md, CONTINUITY_SEED.md (100% match to the dated one), BUILDER_PROMPT_META_RULE_2026-05-15.md, and some python files. clean it up
evals.expected_output: The skill scans, finds the bare CONTINUITY_SEED.md, confirms it is a 100% orphan duplicate of CONTINUITY_SEED_2026-05-01.md, deletes the bare file, confirms the BUILDER_PROMPT file already has canonical naming, and declares the tree clean.
assertions: The skill identifies CONTINUITY_SEED.md as a bare default name requiring attention
The skill performs a diff or comparison against CONTINUITY_SEED_2026-05-01.md
The skill determines the bare file is an orphan duplicate (100% match) and deletes it
The skill recognizes BUILDER_PROMPT_META_RULE_2026-05-15.md as already canonical (no action needed)
The skill declares the gate clean after deletion

evals.prompt: git status shows CONTINUITY_SEED.md modified. i also have CONTINUITY_SEED_2026-05-10.md already committed. but i think the bare one has newer notes i added this morning. what do we do?
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies this as a divergent case (bare differs from canonical sibling), does NOT auto-delete or auto-rename, surfaces the ambiguity to the user, explains the two options (keep the new content by renaming the bare to a new date, or merge the changes manually), and waits for user instruction before any git operation.
assertions: The skill identifies this as a divergent case requiring manual resolution
The skill does NOT auto-delete or silently overwrite either file
The skill surfaces the ambiguity explicitly to the user
The skill suggests a resolution path (rename bare to new date, or merge)
The skill holds the git operation until the user resolves the ambiguity
